evals.prompt: Add a Rename dialog for event graphs in the NetPrints editor. It opens with the current name in a text box that already has focus with all its text selected; Enter or OK accepts and returns the new name; Escape or Cancel closes it and returns null. Write the view (.axaml and .axaml.cs), the view model and a unit test for the view model.
evals.expected_output: A DialogVM<string>-based VM with RequestClose, DialogCloseBehavior on the Window, prebuilt focus/select-all behaviors, no event handlers in XAML, AutomationIds constants, VM test.
assertions: The VM derives from DialogVM<string> and closes through RequestClose
DialogCloseBehavior on the Window, not code-behind Close()
Focus and select-all use prebuilt behaviors, not Focus()/SelectAll() in code-behind
No event handlers in the XAML
AutomationIds constants for the named controls
A unit test covers the view model

evals.prompt: In the class editor window's Output pane (ClassEditorWindow), make the output follow new lines as they arrive, add an icon-only 'Clear output' button, and bind Ctrl+L to the same action. Write the XAML and view-model changes plus tests.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the existing ClearOutputCommand and Clear button in ClassEditorWindow.axaml (no new command). The output text is wrapped in a ScrollViewer carrying AutoScrollToBottomBehavior (the behavior does nothing on a TextBox), no ScrollToEnd in code-behind. Adds KeyBinding Gesture="Ctrl+L" bound to the same command, and makes the button icon-only with AutomationProperties.Name.
assertions: Reuses ClearOutputCommand; no new Clear command
The output text sits inside a ScrollViewer that carries AutoScrollToBottomBehavior
AutoScrollToBottomBehavior is not attached to a TextBox
No ScrollToEnd call in code-behind
KeyBinding Gesture="Ctrl+L" is bound to the same ClearOutputCommand
The Clear button is icon-only and has AutomationProperties.Name

evals.prompt: Let users reorder the methods in the class editor's method list by dragging them. Propose the XAML and view-model changes needed.
evals.expected_output: ContextDragBehavior on a grip separate from the method name (the name is already dragged onto the graph), plus ContextDropBehavior with a DropHandlerBase subclass whose handler calls one undoable VM Move... command. The command has a unit test. No package change.
assertions: No reference to Xaml.Behaviors.Interactions.Draggable
No ListReorderDragBehavior or ItemDragBehavior
ContextDragBehavior starts the drag from a grip separate from the name, which is already dragged onto the graph
ContextDropBehavior uses a DropHandlerBase subclass whose handler calls a VM command
The Move command is undoable and has a unit test

evals.prompt: Let the user copy the selected node's name with Ctrl+C.
evals.expected_output: A VM command that calls IClipboardService, bound with a KeyBinding Gesture="Ctrl+C". No SetClipboardTextAction and no clipboard behavior (references/avoid.md).
assertions: A VM command calls IClipboardService to set the text
A KeyBinding with Gesture Ctrl+C is bound to that command
No SetClipboardTextAction or other clipboard behavior in XAML
No clipboard call in code-behind
